blocks.title: This world
blocks.body:
You are flying through a distributed voxel world written in Rust + Bevy, compiled to WebAssembly. On a server it runs as gateway + Region shards; here the terrain is generated in your browser.

WASD to fly, Space / Shift up and down, hold Ctrl to speed up.
